plugin.name: Aardwolf_Combat_Actions
plugin.author: FesterHead
plugin.purpose: Automated combat commands with death safety checks
plugin.description: Monitors Aardwolf GMCP char.status. Runs a CHANCE_TO_ACT to execute a random command from an approved list, with explicit checks to ensure the enemy isn't dead.

muclient.script:
require "gmcphelper"
-- Configuration local CHANCE_TO_ACT = 50 -- Percentage chance (0 to 100)
-- Approved list of commands local AVAILABLE_COMMANDS = { "kick" }
function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, name, text) -- Look for the standard Aardwolf GMCP handler ID if (id == '3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264') then
-- char.status updates every combat round/pulse when fighting if (text == "char.status") then local gmcpchar = gmcp("char")
-- Verify we have the status data if gmcpchar and gmcpchar.status then local fighting = gmcpchar.status.enemy local enemy_hp = tonumber(gmcpchar.status.enemypct) or 0 local my_state = tonumber(gmcpchar.status.state) or 0
-- SAFETY CHECK 1: Ensure an enemy actually exists if not fighting or fighting == "" or fighting == "None" then return end
-- SAFETY CHECK 2: If enemy health percentage is 0, they are dead! if enemy_hp <= 0 then return end
-- SAFETY CHECK 3: State 8 is typically combat in Aardwolf GMCP. -- If you are idling (3) or resting (0/1), do not attack. if my_state == 3 or my_state == 0 then return end
-- If all safety checks pass, roll the CHANCE_TO_ACT activation check if math.random(1, 100) <= CHANCE_TO_ACT then
-- Pick a random command out of our available list local random_index = math.random(1, #AVAILABLE_COMMANDS) local chosen_command = AVAILABLE_COMMANDS[random_index]
-- Execute the action in the MUD Execute(chosen_command) end
end end
end end
function OnPluginInstall() -- Seed the random number generator so it's truly random each session math.randomseed(os.time()) Note("-> Combat Actions Plugin Loaded. Aggro protection active.") end
